title: refactor(ci): simplify lint/test workflows, consolidate deps and release hygiene
author: Maya Thompson
commits: chore(ci): consolidate lint and test workflows into single pipeline (squash)
chore(ci): remove legacy node14/node16 matrices and standardize to node20
chore(deps): update actions/checkout and setup-node action pins
docs: update docs/ci.md with the new pipeline and troubleshooting notes
description: Context: Over the past 18 months we've accumulated many small, lightly divergent CI workflows across the monorepo. This PR consolidates lint and test pipelines, removes legacy Node matrices, pins GH Actions to vetted versions, and extracts shared job steps to a common workflow to reduce duplication and improve cache locality. Motivation: reduce CI maintenance burden, speed up PR feedback for typical contributor changes, and reduce flakiness caused by inconsistent action versions and environment matrices. Changes: - Consolidated lint.yml and test.yml into two coordinated workflows using a shared common.yml for setup/checkout/cache steps. - Standardized on Node 20 for SDK and repo-level test runs; removed Node 14/16 matrices. - Introduced a lightweight "ci-setup" reusable job that centralizes actions/checkout, setup-node, cache and credential handling. - Pinned frequently-flaky actions (setup-node, actions/cache, actions/checkout) to stable major versions and added short justification comments. - Cleaned up release.yml to use the new reusable jobs and improve event filtering to avoid duplicate release runs from dependabot. - Updated docs/ci.md with new workflow docs and troubleshooting tips. Checklist: - [x] Unit/integration tests pass locally and in CI (flaky tests quarantined with TODOs) - [x] Lint job consolidated and rules standardized - [x] Release workflow event filters adjusted to prevent duplicate runs - [x] Follow-up linear tasks created for full caching tuning and integrating job matrix heuristics Impact: Faster median CI time for PRs touching only SDKs (~25% reduction in wall-clock due to shared caching), fewer flaky runs due to action pinning, and significantly simplified workflow maintenance surface. Rollout plan: Merge to main, monitor PR CI times and flaky rate for 1 week, revert specific action pins if we see regression. Related: ENG-3142 (CI hygiene), ENG-3001 (release automation cleanup), SUP-789 (customer-reported flaky release pipeline).
